caption: Front door — pick a goal in plain words, or just describe the deal.
Ideas from your sales — the blank page becomes “pick a smart idea,” each with a real number.
Describe it — one plain sentence, and the AI fills every box (code and label included).
Step 1 — The deal. Pick the kind, type one number; the unit is built into the box.
Step 2 — Who gets it. One plain choice replaces three confusing checkboxes.
Step 3 — Rules & dates. Optional, with smart defaults; the minimum is anchored to your average order.
Step 4 — Review. See the real card, read plain heads-up notices, then save a draft or turn it on.
The smart heads-up — reads your live coupons and says, in plain words, what wins, what overlaps, what resets.
